aboutH2: Miklat Recovery: Residential Recovery for Men in Powell River
intro: Miklat Recovery Society offers gender-specific care that caters exclusively to men who are dealing with addiction issues. The program’s mission is to assist these men in escaping the cycle of addiction and to provide them with an environment in which they can begin their healing process. The dedicated team of professionals at Miklat seeks to create a climate of emotional and spiritual security that allows clients to rediscover themselves and their sense of purpose. Located in the beautiful region of British Columbia’s Sunshine Coast, the program offers a ten-bed home that is both intimate and welcoming. Clients can take advantage of nature hikes, fishing excursions, and other outdoor activities on weekends.

pillars.title: Life Skills Training
pillars.body: Miklat Recovery Society offers a range of life skills training that encompasses all aspects of daily living. The program places particular emphasis on cultivating healthy habits, maintaining personal hygiene, navigating household duties, and participating in group therapy. Clients at Miklat can take advantage of a range of evidence-based treatment modalities, including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR), and music therapy. The program also offers access to 12 Step meetings and peer-based therapeutic groups, as well as workshops on relapse prevention and anger management. The team of qualified counselors will provide individualized care as they guide clients through the recovery process.

pillars.title: Purpose and Hope
pillars.body: Miklat Recovery Society offers a haven of hope and purpose for men who are struggling with addiction. Our program offers a safe and secure environment in which clients can repair the damage that addiction has wrought. In addition to providing intensive counseling and therapy, we also help clients integrate healthy habits and practices into their daily lives. This includes everything from preparing balanced, nutritious meals to exploring spirituality and attending 12 Step meetings. By helping clients cultivate a sense of purpose and rediscover their passions, we provide an environment in which they can begin to imagine a fulfilling life that is free from addiction.

pillars.title: Pricing Information
pillars.body: Miklat Recovery Society is committed to keeping non-insured costs as low as possible. Clients are welcome to use their insurance to offset the cost of treatment. The program costs $4,000 per month, with a primary stay of about 90 days. For those who choose to participate in the full 90-day program, the cost is $12,000.

overview: Miklat Recovery Society is an addiction rehab center designed to offer refuge and support to men struggling with drug and alcohol addiction. As a non-profit registered charity, Miklat Recovery Society provides cost-effective residential programs that include counseling, peer groups, life skills, anger management, and professional drug and alcohol counseling. The experienced addiction treatment staff at Miklat is made up of individuals who have worked in the field of addictions counseling and treatment, which includes those who have overcome addiction themselves.

Miklat Recovery Society’s mission is to provide a nurturing environment for their clients to flourish and become active members of society. This is accomplished through supporting their clients through their journey in and out of residential treatment. The program has been designed to foster growth, with a research-based residential care, a high level of clinical counseling, trauma-informed therapy, evidence-based practices, structured programming, one-on-one counseling, and opioid agonist therapy. Members of Miklat Recovery Society can also participate in hiking, swimming, fishing, and other outdoor activities. The services provided by Miklat Recovery Society have been designed with abstinence in mind, which is important in giving their clients the best chance to succeed.

afterOverview: Miklat now runs from two homes in Powell River. McGuffie, at 5298 McGuffie Avenue, is the original house where the program started. Arbutus Place, at 5907 Arbutus Avenue, opened in September 2025 inside the old Townsite fire hall and has 12 beds. The program is operated by Together We Can Drug & Alcohol Recovery & Education Society, and the team includes program manager Rob Fitzpatrick, addiction counsellor Nina Peers (CCAC), psychotherapist Tricia McTaggart (RCC), client care workers and a chef. Men are referred by family, health professionals, counsellors, Indigenous supports and justice-system partners, and they can also call on their own.

location.heading: Miklat Recovery in Powell River, British Columbia
location.intro: Miklat's two homes are in Powell River, in the qathet region at the north end of BC's Sunshine Coast, with Arbutus Place in the historic Townsite. Getting here from Vancouver takes about 5 hours by road with the Horseshoe Bay to Langdale and Earls Cove to Saltery Bay ferries, or a short flight, and men from Vancouver Island can take the roughly 90-minute ferry from Comox.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Miklat Recovery cost?
faqs.a: Miklat's recovery.com profile gives an estimated cash-pay rate of $4,000 for 30 days and $12,000 for the full 90-day primary care stay, in Canadian dollars. The program's own website doesn't publish fees, so check the current rate when you call. Insurance can be used, and donations to Together We Can help fund program subsidies.

faqs.q: How long does the program last?
faqs.a: The Miklat Recovery Society program has a primary phase of about 90 days, followed by optional sober living and aftercare.

No. Miklat is a residential and supportive recovery program, and its recovery.com profile lists detox as not offered. If you need withdrawal management, hospital care or crisis support first, the intake team will talk through next steps with you before admission.

faqs.q: Where is Miklat Recovery and how do I get there?
faqs.a: Miklat has two registered homes in Powell River, in the qathet region at the top of BC's Sunshine Coast: Arbutus Place at 5907 Arbutus Avenue and the original house at 5298 McGuffie Avenue. From Vancouver it's about 5 hours by road with the Horseshoe Bay and Earls Cove ferries, or a short flight. From Vancouver Island, the Comox ferry takes about 90 minutes.

faqs.q: Is Miklat Recovery the same as Miklat Recovery Society?
faqs.a: Yes. The program was listed here as Miklat Recovery Society and now goes by Miklat Recovery. It is operated by Together We Can Drug & Alcohol Recovery & Education Society, a registered Canadian charity, and still runs the original McGuffie house along with Arbutus Place.

faqs.q: What type of addiction can be treated at Miklat?
faqs.a: The program is designed to treat drug and alcohol addiction.
Yes. Miklat Recovery Society accepts insurance and works to keep non-insured costs low.

faqs.q: What happens after the primary phase?
faqs.a: Most men move into a sober living phase of 3 to 18 months, when they go back to work or school while still living in the house with in-house support and a weekly meeting. Before leaving, each client also gets a written aftercare plan built around where he will live, his health needs and his own relapse triggers.

faqs.q: What types of therapy modalities are used at Miklat?
faqs.a: The program utilizes several evidence-based modalities, including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR), and music therapy.

faqs.q: Is there Indigenous or cultural programming?
faqs.a: Yes. The program describes regular sweat lodge ceremonies, smudging and brushings led by its Cultural Lead, and teachings about connection to land, spirit and community. It says these are safe, respectful spaces for both Indigenous and non-Indigenous participants. Miklat sits on the traditional, ancestral and unceded territory of the Tla’amin Nation.

faqs.q: Can clients participate in outdoor activities?
faqs.a: Yes. Clients can participate in a range of outdoor activities like nature hikes, fishing, and other excursions on weekends.

faqs.q: Does Miklat Recovery Society offer individualized treatment?
faqs.a: Yes. The team of compassionate professionals provides individualized care and attention to each client.
